maps.title: F4ll
maps.author: BCDeshiG
maps.description: Prevent the tragedy from ever occurring; Bring the fight to their turf. To their people. To their blood.

maps.title: B1ooD Version 3
maps.author: BCDeshiG
maps.description: The original. 3 rooms, the usual perks, MBox and PaP. Good for quick challenges and high round attempts.

maps.title: B1ooD Version 4
maps.author: BCDeshiG
maps.description: It's all too familiar to me... I thought it all ended. There's still blood on my hands but this time... I won't fall to darkness.

maps.title: Boxxer
maps.author: Naievil (suggested by jardo420)
maps.description: As suggested this map is essentially a box. I DID go into this map and give it a bit of detail and use suggestive coloring and whatnot...but it's just a box. Zombies come from the ground so get ready to get pissed off, seriously. This map is a pain.

maps.title: Bunker Defense
maps.author: Revnova
maps.description: Try and see how long you can last in this Bunker you've locked yourself in. Keep eyes out for some Teddys

maps.title: Christmas Special
maps.author: NZ:P Team
maps.description: No Santa this year. Though we're sure you will get some presents from the undead! Will you accept them?

maps.title: Dung3on
maps.author: BCDeshiG
maps.description: Explore the castle sewers, dealing with knee high water and looping corridors. Took me years to make lol. Also features navmesh.

maps.title: Fegefeuer
maps.author: Stoohp
maps.description: Welcome to purgatory, friend. An old Nazi base; Purposeless. Resistance is futile. Death's cold grip will take you. Your body will never be found. You will never even be remembered. Good luck.

maps.title: Hangar
maps.author: Jacob Giguere
maps.description: It's fight or flight and you can't find fuel. If only scavenging for fuel is as easy as erasing the horde.

maps.title: House
maps.author: Lexi
maps.description: A rural house is your last hope for survival as the zombies advance. The classic map, remade and re-balanced with perks and unlockable Pack-a-Punch!

maps.title: Overlook
maps.author: Lexi
maps.description: Don't overlook the zombies coming to kill you. The classic map remade, but don't expect survival to be easy.

maps.title: Temple
maps.author: Lexi
maps.description: Zombies advance on these jungle ruins. Something lurks in the darkness. The classic map, remade and re-balanced with perks and unlockable Pack-a-Punch!

maps.title: Loop
maps.author: BCDeshiG
maps.description: Tight spaces, 1 big ring. No perks? Just mbox + PaP Bring on the buggers!

maps.title: Nacht der Untoten
maps.author: NZ:P Team
maps.description: Desolate bunker located on a German airfield, stranded after a brutal plane crash surrounded by hordes of undead. Exploit mysterious forces at play and hold out against relentless waves. Der Anstieg ist jetzt. Will you fall to the overwhelming onslaught?

maps.title: Warehouse (Classic)
maps.author: NZ:P Team
maps.description: Old Warehouse full of Zombies! Fight your way to the Power Switch through the Hordes!

maps.title: Warehouse
maps.author: NZ:P Team
maps.description: Four nameless marines find themselves at a forsaken warehouse, or is it something more? Fight your way to uncovering its secrets, though you may not like what you find..

maps.title: Tikhaya Noch
maps.author: NZ:P Team
maps.description: Following the events of Warehouse, the OSS dispatches marines to recover yet another secret artifact in an abandoned Soviet Facility.

maps.title: Wahnsinn
maps.author: NZ:P Team
maps.description: An abandoned and bleak mental house surrounded by debris and fog. Teddy is deceitful, find him. (WORK IN PROGRESS, NOT FINISHED)

maps.title: Firing Range
maps.author: Derped_Crusader
maps.description: Started as a Devmap for testing guns and ADS values, it got furnished and turned into a place for everyone to do tests of all kinds
